notes.text: Design: added registerExporter("beads") -> pm beads export (stdout or --output), kept registerImporter("beads") -> pm beads import. registerItemFields([bead_id]) (capability schema; manifest already lists commands/schema/importers, importers covers the exporter). Original Beads id persisted via [bead_id: <id>] marker in description (pm create has no generic custom-field setter for standalone extensions) and re-emitted on export. Beads dependencies/blocked_by edges mapped to pm blocked_by deps via two-pass import (create all, then update --dep id=<pmId>,kind=blocked_by); export translates pm ids back to bead ids. Flags: --preserve-ids default on (--no-preserve-ids to disable), --output/-o for export, plus existing --dry-run/--type/--priority/--tags. Renamed legacy rich-help commands to beads-import/beads-export to avoid command_handler_collision with the importer/exporter-auto-created commands. Verification: npm run build clean, npx tsc --noEmit clean, npm test 9/9 pass. Functional: pm init+install, extension doctor active 0 failures 0 collisions; imported 3-record JSONL with ids+2 dep edges, exported back, asserted all ids+deps survived round-trip; --no-preserve-ids emits pm-* ids.

notes.author: codex
notes.text: SDK/CLI finding (report only): 'pm update <id> --status closed' on an already-closed item fails with exit_code 4 ('already terminal; use --force to close again'). This breaks naive upsert of closed items; worked around by omitting --status when the mapped status equals the item's current status. Suggest pm treat a no-op terminal->same-terminal status update as idempotent (no --force) so importers/sync tools can re-assert state safely.

notes.text: Implemented 'beads-validate <file>' command (rich-help alias; pm routes 'beads <verb>' only for importer/exporter names, so validate ships as a command). Pure validateBeadsText() covers invalid JSON, non-object lines, missing title, unknown status (warning), duplicate id (warning), dangling dependency refs (error). --json returns structured report on stdout via runtime serialization (read global --json from ctx.global) with process.exitCode for nonzero-without-throw so the report survives; human mode lists issues on stderr + throws CommandError(1). Functionally verified: bad file exit 1 with all classes detected, clean file exit 0.

notes.author: codex
notes.text: DECISION (dedup key): Key upsert on the bead_id provenance marker the round-trip already uses ([bead_id: <id>] in description), NOT on tags. Rationale: SDK case-folds tags on storage (sibling dedup bug), so a tag-based key would mangle mixed-case bead ids. The description marker is case-preserving and is the same mechanism the exporter reads, so import/export/re-import stay consistent. On --upsert: build bead-id->pm-id index from existing items (decodeBeadId over list-all), update matched items, create unmatched. Items without a bead id (no --preserve-ids) cannot be keyed -> always create (documented).

Issue #98 does NOT bite this id=..,kind=.. form. Upsert reuses pass-2 wiring but dedups edges via --replace-deps so re-import does not append duplicate deps.
